_readme: Single override file for generated verdict copy (design/article-format-spec.md C3, C9); shape documented in tradersfundhub/design/phase1-copy-drafts.md. reviews.<post slug>: verdict (string replaces the review's first Verdict sentence; null hides it), bestFor / notFor (arrays, max 2 shown). compares.<canonical matchup>: pickA / pickB (arrays, max 3 shown; A is the firm named first in the slug). A missing key uses the data-built lines. Overrides must not add figures that are not in firms.json or the challenge captures.

bestFor: Fixed floors: Alpha Pro max loss is static at 6%, 8% or 10%
Small budgets: Alpha Pro 6% on-demand starts at $27 for $5K
notFor: Big-day traders on on-demand plans: they carry a 40% consistency rule
Anyone wanting a fee refund: no Alpha Capital fee is refundable

bestFor: Getting your fee back: every BrightFunded account size is refundable
